rules.title: First Encounter
rules.shortSummary: Only the first valid encounter in an eligible area may be used.

versions.description: Each player may only use the first valid encounter for an encounter opportunity unless another rule explicitly grants a reroll or exception.

rules.title: Linked Fates
rules.shortSummary: If one linked Pokémon dies, its partner is retired as well.

versions.summary: A death ends the whole Soul Link.
versions.description: When either member of a Soul Link faints permanently, that Pokémon is recorded as dead and its linked partner is retired because the link was lost.

rules.title: Gift Pokémon
rules.shortSummary: Gift encounters are tracked as their own encounter opportunities when the run permits them.

versions.description: The companion can represent gift and static encounters independently from a location's main encounter. Whether they are legal is controlled by the run rules.
